import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Scanner;

class CF375B_V1 {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        Integer.parseInt(sc.nextLine());
        String s = sc.next().toLowerCase();
        int n = s.length();

        List<Integer> parens = new ArrayList<Integer>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = s.charAt(i);
            if (c == '(' || c == ')') parens.add(i);
        }

        boolean[] inside = new boolean[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < parens.size(); i += 2) {
            int start = parens.get(i);
            int end = parens.get(i + 1);
            for (int j = start; j <= end; j++) inside[j] = true;
        }

        int insideWords = 0;
        boolean previousNormal = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (!inside[i]) continue;
            char c = s.charAt(i);
            if (c == '(' || c == ')' || c == '_') {
                previousNormal = false;
            } else {
                if (!previousNormal) insideWords++;
                previousNormal = true;
            }
        }

        String replaced = s.replaceAll("\\(.*?\\) ?", " ").replace("_", " ");
        String[] tokens = replaced.split(" ");
        List<Integer> outside = new ArrayList<Integer>();
        for (String token : tokens) {
            if (token.trim().length() != 0) outside.add(token.length());
        }
        Collections.sort(outside);

        int maxOutside = outside.isEmpty() ? 0 : outside.get(outside.size() - 1);
        System.out.print(maxOutside + " " + insideWords);
    }
}

        int n = s.length();

        BitSet inside = new BitSet(n);
        List<Integer> parens = new ArrayList<Integer>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = s.charAt(i);
            if (c == '(' || c == ')') parens.add(i);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < parens.size(); i += 2) {
            inside.set(parens.get(i), parens.get(i + 1) + 1);
        }

        int insideWords = 0;
        boolean previousNormal = false;
        for (int i = inside.nextSetBit(0); i >= 0; i = inside.nextSetBit(i + 1)) {
            char c = s.charAt(i);
            if (c == '(' || c == ')' || c == '_') {
                previousNormal = false;
            } else {
                if (!previousNormal) insideWords++;
                previousNormal = true;
            }
        }

        String replaced = s.replaceAll("\\(.*?\\) ?", " ").replace("_", " ");
        OptionalInt max = Arrays.stream(replaced.split(" "))
